nodes.label: Constitution
nodes.description: The Island is a self-governing Crown Dependency with its own institutions.

nodes.label: Crown Dependency status
nodes.description: The Isle of Man has its own parliament, government and laws and is outside the United Kingdom.

nodes.label: Lord of Mann & Lieutenant Governor
nodes.description: The monarch holds the title Lord of Mann; the Lieutenant Governor represents the Crown on the Island.

nodes.label: Relationship with the UK
nodes.description: The constitutional relationship is through the Crown; the UK is responsible for defence and international relations.

source.label: UK Ministry of Justice · Crown Dependencies

nodes.label: Parliament — Tynwald
nodes.description: The Keys and Council consider legislation separately and sit together as Tynwald Court.

nodes.label: House of Keys
nodes.description: The directly elected branch of Tynwald, where primary legislation is normally introduced.

nodes.label: Legislative Council
nodes.description: Tynwald’s revising branch; it considers legislation passed by the House of Keys.

nodes.label: Tynwald Court
nodes.description: The two branches sitting together to debate policy, finance and other parliamentary business.

nodes.label: Executive government
nodes.description: The executive develops policy and manages public services.

nodes.label: Council of Ministers
nodes.description: The Chief Minister and ministers form the executive Council of Ministers.

nodes.description: Supports government leadership and coordinates policy and services across departments.

nodes.label: Education, Sport and Culture
nodes.description: Provides educational, sporting and cultural opportunities for children, young people and adults.

nodes.label: Enterprise
nodes.description: Supports economic development, local entrepreneurship and businesses establishing or growing on the Island.

nodes.label: Environment, Food and Agriculture
nodes.description: Protects the natural environment and oversees policy for animal health and welfare, food, farming and fisheries.

nodes.label: Health and Social Care
nodes.description: Sets health and social care priorities, policy and funding, and monitors services delivered by Manx Care.

nodes.label: Home Affairs
nodes.description: Oversees policing, fire and rescue, prison and probation services, and emergency planning and communications.

nodes.label: Infrastructure
nodes.description: Provides services covering highways, harbours, the airport, transport, housing, flood management and waste management.

nodes.label: The Treasury
nodes.description: Manages public finances and provides tax, customs and immigration, social security and financial oversight services.
